_comment: Identity/notes sidecar for the #421 tower-profile close-out artifact (pod p421, run2). Carries ONLY textual/declared provenance that has no numeric measurement to assert (device model strings, HF checkpoint repo+file names, prose) -- every NUMBER in the produced artifact (git_sha, box, p2_witnessed, status, checkpoint sha256, per-step wall/front/busy, chain shares, launches_per_step, ...) is read live off profile_421_merge.py / profile_421_attribute.py / the raw legs-dir / p2-dir by ci/scripts/perf/profile_421_artifact.py, never off this file. `recorded_deviations` entries are TEMPLATES: any number the prose needs to quote (a chain share, a validity-gate bound, a corpus file/row count) is a `{placeholder}` (see profile_421_artifact.py's `_identity_template_context`), filled from a live source -- this file must never carry a bare digit standing in for a measurement (enforced by test_profile_421_artifact.py's own regex test over this exact committed file). The ONE exception is `operator_recorded`: a fact an operator observed on-pod with NO in-tree witness at all (e.g. an off-pod raw-export disk-usage total, measured by a `du` this repo never captured) -- allowed to carry a number as plain, un-re-derivable text, explicitly OUTSIDE the recorded_deviations guarantee. Consumed by: python3 ci/scripts/perf/profile_421_artifact.py --identity ci/scripts/perf/profile_421_run2_identity.json ...
what: GH #421 tower training-step profile close-out: pre-registered (contract v2.5, frozen 2026-09-07 before measurement) census of the CLIP-text, OpenCLIP-vision and HTSAT LoRA training steps. Decides the candidate ports the contract names (C-ATTN-CLIP-text, C-ATTN-CLIP-vision, C-MLP-CLIP-text, C-MLP-CLIP-vision) and reports the already-realized fused-kernel gains (C-LORA, C-LN, C-GELU-HTSAT joint) plus the out-of-tier, named-but-undecided C-ATTN-HTSAT chain.
nsys_human: Nsight Systems 2025.3.2.474 (dnf-installed from the cuda-rhel8 repo; the pod image's own cuda-12.6 shim and an unpinned 2026.1.3 build were both refused by the job script)
recorded_deviations: run1 (pod p421, session 1) was ALL-12-LEGS INVALID at the pre-fix tip (esc-088: profile_421_legs.sh's corpus tuple shared stdout with its own producers, fixed by PR #469, main c1b0b0ba) -- this artifact is the full 12-leg re-run (run2) on the merged fix.

ROOT CAUSE of the run2-pass1..3 'A2 legs INVALID for attribution -> F32-only' state (pass-4 item 1, kernel_census.py): the module keyed each GPU-kernel bucket on shortName alone, and cutlass's Kernel2<...> template wrapper (same latent shape in magma_sgemmEx_kernel<...>) gives every bf16 GEMM tile instantiation the SAME literal shortName -- clip-text-A2's own run_m.sqlite has {kernel_identity_split_count} DISTINCT cutlass instantiations sharing shortName='Kernel2' AND grid/block, so keying on shortName summed them into one anonymous row that tripped profile_421_attribute.py's {unknown_kernel_share_limit_pct:.0f}% known-kernel-name gate. FIX: key on COALESCE(demangledName, shortName) instead -- a strict refinement (a bucket can only split, never merge two old buckets into fewer new ones), so gpu_kernel_us_per_step stays bit-identical and only by_kernel_and_grid resplits; only the cutlass Kernel2<...>(T1::Params) wrapper is stripped to its inner tile name, every other demangled name (magma's own template signature, splitKreduce_kernel<...>) is kept as-is since its template arguments are what distinguishes real instantiations there. All {leg_count} censuses were regenerated under the fix for this run2 pass-4 pull -- every top-line number (gpu_kernel_us_per_step, wall/front/busy per_step) is UNCHANGED (sum-preserving refinement); only the per-instantiation by_kernel_and_grid breakdown resplit. Both CLIP-tower A2 legs (clip-text-A2, clip-vision-A2) are now VALID and decision-grade for attribution -- every candidate-port decision below is measured on BOTH the F32 (A1) and BF16 (A2) legs, never F32-only by consequence.

htsat-A2 (bf16) is {htsat_a2_merge_verdict} at the merge level but {htsat_a2_decision_grade_word} for attribution: UNATTRIBUTED share_gpu_busy is {htsat_a2_unattributed_share_gpu_busy_pct:.2f}%, over the contract's {unattributed_decision_grade_limit_pct:.0f}% validity bound. Root cause: WINDOWING (window-partition/reverse/roll copies) and FRONT-FUSION (the audio front end's own activation) are still UNDECLARED chains -- a window-partition copy sits at the identical element count as a generic residual-stream PERMUTE/RESHAPE copy, so profile_421_attribute.py has no shape-only way to tell them apart, and declares neither rather than guess (module doc, 'declaring a chain with no matching rule is dishonest'). htsat-A1 (f32) clears the bound under the pass-4 census fix and IS decision-grade. HTSAT has no candidate port under this contract in the first place (C-ATTN-HTSAT is a named, measured, declared-out-of-tier chain, never folded into UNATTRIBUTED), so htsat-A2's own non-decision-grade status never blocks a candidate-port decision.

Per-leg raw .nsys-rep exports were deleted on-pod after each leg's census.json was produced (disk budget); the raw sqlite exports ({sqlite_raw_export_count} files) were kept off-pod and were never committed -- see notes.operator_recorded for the on-pod-recorded total size, which has no in-tree witness.

Both media corpus producers (image, audio) emit families x instances = {corpus_total_files} files at any --rows, so the M-leg's {corpus_rows_m} rows cycle {corpus_train_clips} distinct train clips (a page-cached working set, contract SS D6.3) -- the HTSAT/vision front-end finding below is a real per-item CPU decode/preprocess compute cost, not a realistic-corpus I/O cost, and every quote of that finding must carry this caveat.

Census reports produced before the pass-4 kernel-identity fix (the #356 close-out and the #421 2026-09-01/06 pod artifacts) carry the pre-fix, collapsed Kernel2/magma_sgemmEx_kernel rows in by_kernel_and_grid -- their by_kernel_name totals and every other top-line number are unaffected (the refinement is sum-preserving, see the root-cause deviation above), only the per-instantiation breakdown was coarser.

CONTRACT.md's own SS D5 (docs/plans/66-tower-profile/CONTRACT.md, frozen body) names profile_421_merge.py's hermetic suite at a fixed pre-registration-time count -- already stale at the freeze commit (perf/421-profile-p1 @ aace002f), where the live suite (unittest discovery over the REAL committed test_profile_421_merge.py, never hand-typed -- see profile_421_artifact.py's compute_merge_suite_test_count) already carried {merge_suite_test_count} tests; unchanged at c1b0b0ba. Not corrected in the frozen body -- a pre-registration's text is never edited after freezing -- recorded here instead, per docs/plans/66-tower-profile/README.md's own 'Deviations from a clean single pass' section (see CONTRACT.md SS D5 itself, never quoted here as a second, independently-drifting digit, for the exact stale figure it names). The count is descriptive prose about the suite's size, not a method parameter any decision rule reads, so this staleness never affected a verdict.

operator_recorded.raw_sqlite_export_total_size: ~31 GB (on-pod estimate at run2 close-out, before the exports were deleted per the disk-budget deviation above; the raw .sqlite files themselves were never committed, so no in-tree witness can re-derive this figure -- the file COUNT in notes.recorded_deviations IS witnessed, this size is not)

producer_invocation: identity (nvidia-smi, /proc/cpuinfo) -> nsys --version (pinned 2025.3.2.474, fails loudly if absent) -> build (cargo build --release -p jammi-bench --features cuda; JAMMI_BUILD_SHA baked from a byte-identical checkout) -> checkpoints (huggingface_hub fetch of the pinned per-repo file sets) -> PROFILE_421_LEGS_PREFLIGHT_ONLY=1 ci/scripts/perf/profile_421_legs.sh -> PROFILE_421_P2_BF16=1 ci/scripts/perf/profile_421_legs.sh + profile_421_merge.py --p2-dir -> ci/scripts/perf/profile_421_legs.sh (12 legs) -> profile_421_merge.py --legs-dir --p2-dir -> profile_421_attribute.py --legs-dir --merge-json
